name: Zao Asian Cafe (Draper & South Jordan, UT) Mild Yellow Coconut Chicken Curry & Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Zao Asian Cafe (Draper & South Jordan, UT)
whyItWorks: Mild coconut milk curry with turmeric, diced chicken breast, and tender carrots served over white jasmine rice. Turmeric provides anti-inflammatory curcumin, and coconut milk is naturally lactose-free.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Yellow Curry Rice Bowl with chicken breast and white rice (hold raw jalapeños and spicy sambal).
watchOuts: Skip spicy red chili oil or jalapeño toppings
